summary: The terminal UI reads only visible foreground thread messages and offers private unread reminders with per-anchor clearing

replay.detail: The client uses the existing thread read and unread reminder actions; no replay policy changes.

schema.detail: No additional schema or generated client changes beyond the composed unread API dependency.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Uses negotiated thread.read access and the composed thread unread actions and timeline-around read. Read-only connections hide mark actions. Existing natural read history is preserved.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or startup work.

manual.detail: Mark read and Mark unread are available in Ctrl+K and the thread panel, with v/u or alt+v/alt+u where letters type. Inbox lists private marked-unread threads.

recovery.detail: No new local persistent state. Reminders remain authoritative on the member across client restarts.
